gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.53358 38.672428)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.53358 38.672428)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.802535 41.805303)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.802535 41.805303)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Good Samaritan Hospital, Vincennes, IN'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Chicago Portage National Historic Site, Lyons, IL'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-87.53358, 38.672428), 4326)::geometry AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-87.802535, 41.805303), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    ST_Value(r.rast, p.geom) AS elevation
  FROM 
    points_of_interest p
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom)
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN elevation = (SELECT MAX(elevation) FROM elevation_values) THEN id END) AS higher_elevation_entity,
  MAX(elevation) AS max_elevation
FROM 
  elevation_values;
